import pytest
import torch
from paperleet.common.asserts import assert_close_located as close
from problems.ai_infra.zero.experiment import run

@pytest.mark.t0
def test_contract(impl):
    """Optimizer states share owner layout and step starts at one."""
    p=torch.ones(2,2,dtype=torch.float64); g=torch.ones(2,4,dtype=torch.float64); z=p*0
    out=impl.zero2_adam_step(p,g,z,z,1,.1)
    assert all(t.shape==p.shape and t.dtype==p.dtype for t in out)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): impl.zero2_adam_step(p,g,z,z,0,.1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): impl.state_bytes(7,2,2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): impl.state_bytes(8,2,4)

@pytest.mark.t1
def test_hand_adam_and_reduce_scatter(impl):
    """Opposing replica gradients cancel in owner zero while owner one averages to 2 and -2."""
    p=torch.tensor([[1.,2.],[3.,4.]],dtype=torch.float64); g=torch.tensor([[1.,2.,3.,-1.],[-1.,-2.,1.,-3.]],dtype=torch.float64)
    before=p.clone(); z=torch.zeros_like(p); q,m,v=impl.zero2_adam_step(p,g,z,z,1,.1,beta1=.5,beta2=.75,eps=.5)
    close(m,torch.tensor([[0.,0.],[1.,-1.]],dtype=torch.float64)); close(v,torch.tensor([[0.,0.],[1.,1.]],dtype=torch.float64))
    close(q,torch.tensor([[1.,2.],[2.92,4.08]],dtype=torch.float64)); close(p,before)

@pytest.mark.t1
def test_memory_stages(impl):
    """For eight parameters over four ranks, stage footprints are 128,56,44,32 bytes."""
    assert [impl.state_bytes(8,4,s) for s in range(4)]==[128,56,44,32]

@pytest.mark.t2
def test_replica_permutation_and_single_rank(impl):
    """Data-rank order is irrelevant and world size one recovers ordinary Adam."""
    p=torch.arange(6,dtype=torch.float64).reshape(3,2); g=torch.arange(18,dtype=torch.float64).reshape(3,6)/7; z=p*0
    one=impl.zero2_adam_step(p,g,z,z,3,.03); two=impl.zero2_adam_step(p,g[[2,0,1]],z,z,3,.03)
    for a,b in zip(one,two): close(a,b)
    for s in range(4): assert impl.state_bytes(8,1,s)==128

@pytest.mark.t2
def test_nonzero_moments_and_zero_gradient(impl):
    """Stored moments still move parameters on a zero-gradient step; moments are not reinitialized."""
    p=torch.ones(1,2,dtype=torch.float64); g=torch.zeros(1,2,dtype=torch.float64); m=p*.2; v=p*.4
    q,a,b=impl.zero2_adam_step(p,g,m,v,2,.1,beta1=.5,beta2=.5,eps=.01)
    close(a,p*.1); close(b,p*.2)
    expected=1-.1*(.1/.75)/((.2/.75)**.5+.01); close(q,p*expected)

@pytest.mark.t3
def test_sharded_training(impl,artifact):
    """Two-rank sharded updates reproduce dense Adam through the entire regression trace."""
    r=run(impl.zero2_adam_step,impl.state_bytes); artifact('zero_training',r)
    assert r['metrics']['trajectory_error']<1e-12
    assert r['metrics']['final_loss']<r['metrics']['initial_loss']*.05
    assert r['metrics']['stage2_bytes']<r['metrics']['replicated_bytes']

import torch

def evaluate(zero2_adam_step,state_bytes):
    x=torch.cos(torch.arange(48,dtype=torch.float64).reshape(12,4)*.37); target=x@torch.tensor([.6,-.7,.3,1.],dtype=torch.float64)
    p=torch.zeros(2,2,dtype=torch.float64); m=p.clone(); v=p.clone(); dense=p.reshape(-1).clone(); dm=dense.clone(); dv=dense.clone(); losses=[]; errors=[]
    for step in range(1,46):
        gradients=torch.stack([2*x[r*6:(r+1)*6].T@(x[r*6:(r+1)*6]@p.reshape(-1)-target[r*6:(r+1)*6])/6 for r in range(2)])
        p,m,v=zero2_adam_step(p,gradients,m,v,step,.04)
        g=2*x.T@(x@dense-target)/12; dm=.9*dm+.1*g; dv=.999*dv+.001*g*g
        dense=dense-.04*(dm/(1-.9**step))/(torch.sqrt(dv/(1-.999**step))+1e-8)
        losses.append(float(((x@p.reshape(-1)-target)**2).mean())); errors.append(float((p.reshape(-1)-dense).abs().max()))
    memory=[state_bytes(1024,8,s) for s in range(4)]
    return {'initial_loss':losses[0],'final_loss':losses[-1],'trajectory_error':max(errors),'replicated_bytes':memory[0],'stage2_bytes':memory[2]}, [('Sharded regression',list(range(1,46)),[('MSE',losses)]),('Model-state bytes per rank',list(range(4)),[('Bytes',memory)])]


def run(zero2_adam_step, state_bytes):
    metrics, charts = evaluate(zero2_adam_step, state_bytes)
    return {'kind': 'toy_experiment', 'title': 'ZeRO-2 Sharded Adam and State Memory', 'problem': 'ai_infra/zero', 'provenance': {'kind': 'teaching_adaptation', 'source': 'https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.02054', 'anchor': 'Sections 5.1–5.3: optimizer, gradient and parameter partitioning', 'adaptation': 'Two ranks process deterministic regression examples for 45 Adam steps at learning rate 0.04. Compare with an independent unsharded Adam update and report losses and model-state bytes.'}, 'metrics': metrics, 'charts': [{'kind':'line','title': title,'x_label':'Experiment coordinate','x':x,'series':[{'name':name,'values':values} for name,values in series]} for title,x,series in charts]}

import torch
from torch import Tensor

def zero2_adam_step(params: Tensor, gradients: Tensor, first: Tensor, second: Tensor, step: int, lr: float, beta1: float = .9, beta2: float = .999, eps: float = 1e-8) -> tuple[Tensor,Tensor,Tensor]:
    if params.ndim!=2 or min(params.shape)<=0 or first.shape!=params.shape or second.shape!=params.shape or gradients.shape!=(params.shape[0],params.numel()):
        raise ValueError('incompatible owner shards and gradient replicas')
    if type(step) is not int or step<1 or lr<=0 or eps<=0 or not 0<=beta1<1 or not 0<=beta2<1:
        raise ValueError('invalid Adam hyperparameters')
    if any(t.dtype!=params.dtype or t.device!=params.device for t in (gradients,first,second)) or bool((second<0).any()):
        raise ValueError('matching tensors and nonnegative variance required')
    g=gradients.mean(dim=0).reshape(params.shape)
    m=beta1*first+(1-beta1)*g
    v=beta2*second+(1-beta2)*g*g
    updated=params-lr*(m/(1-beta1**step))/(torch.sqrt(v/(1-beta2**step))+eps)
    return updated,m,v

def state_bytes(parameters: int, world_size: int, stage: int) -> int:
    if type(parameters) is not int or type(world_size) is not int or parameters<=0 or world_size<=0 or parameters%world_size or type(stage) is not int or stage not in (0,1,2,3):
        raise ValueError('equal nonempty shards and stage 0..3 required')
    weights=2*parameters//(world_size if stage>=3 else 1)
    gradients=2*parameters//(world_size if stage>=2 else 1)
    optimizer=12*parameters//(world_size if stage>=1 else 1)
    return weights+gradients+optimizer
